goal: Support a specified semantic subset independent of real project identity; enumerate all native constructs so unreviewed kinds cannot silently become supported.
supportMeaning: A construct is reusable when native analysis succeeds for the retained region, dependencies close over immutable providers or the retained owner, current boundaries are rebound, nominal identity and reference/diagnostic profiles are preserved, and retained memory fits the configured budget. Syntax acceptance alone is insufficient.

targetFamilies.scope: Module/program/interface declarations, parameters, typedefs, integral and real arithmetic, aggregate values, assignments, processes, functions/tasks and generate; builtin gates and net inout boundaries
targetFamilies.remaining: Gate metadata/delays, complete declaration dependency closure, inherited contexts and every relevant hidden AST dependency require qualification

targetFamilies.scope: Builtin scalar/integral/real/string/event types, packed aggregates, fixed arrays, dynamic containers and closed class/interface types; immutable nominal origins and deep parameter values
targetFamilies.remaining: Generalize constant dependency checks and ensure external type specializations close consistently across subtree owners

targetFamilies.scope: Opt-in argument-only binder contracts plus explicit context certificates for nonargument state; never execute runtime IO or random operations during reuse
targetFamilies.remaining: Inventory every native binder category; unknown binders use ordinary analysis instead of being inferred safe from call names

targetFamilies.scope: Existing certified assertions/classes/coverage retained; extend only where all declarations, default expressions, expanded arguments, clock/disable and hidden symbols have been audited
targetFamilies.remaining: Complete statement/timing/pattern audit; explicitly bound unsupported checker, clocking alias and constraint contexts

targetFamilies.scope: Fixed descendants and fixed provider declarations retained. Root connection and override expressions bound in current consumer; dependencies into mutable external scope reject whole-root reuse
targetFamilies.remaining: Maximal safe child fallback without rebuilding or charging entire models once per child; correct bind/interface closure and multiple tops

intentionalLimits: Fixed and mutable code must occupy separate physical files; mixed-file projection is outside this goal
Dependencies assumed immutable until explicit rebuild; changes are not silently accepted as cache hits

No promise of support for every slang syntax in every context; specify, UDP tables, user-defined net resolution, ref-port aliases, defparam/config overrides and unclosed checker/clocking environments require an explicit proof before admission
Fatal/uncertified errors, missing provider identity or changed options require ordinary analysis
Configured retained cache budget is not RSS; exceeding it must not corrupt analysis or disable safe existing hits
invariants: No retained reference into an obsolete mutable consumer
Nominal types preserve identity, not only structural equality
Runtime values are never memoized by semantic binding reuse
Native current boundary diagnostics, whole project diagnostic publication, usage and query results remain equivalent
Independent owners do not form chains across editing generations
A rejected parent does not imply rejected descendants
Status distinguishes requested roots, prepared declarations, retained bodies and bodies actually imported into current model

implementationNotes.constantDependencies: Shared semantic reference rule for names preserved in source, bound expressions and folded defaults. Declaration identity distinguishes native type-parameter aliases from ordinary local typedefs. Packed aggregate member access retains the provenance of its constant base. Public defaults remain parameter-only. Projection and Native parity fixtures pass at checkpoint06.
implementationNotes.bindEffects: Global compatibility proof is cached first. For an already bound ordinary subtree with complete visible types/calls, unrelated mutable module-target binds may be excluded using the concrete instance definition closure. Opaque class/interface/foreign-call contexts and hierarchical targets keep the conservative global proof. Importing definitions invalidates a prior global proof. New tests change target, parameter value, errors and repair.
implementationNotes.partialReuseEvidence: SPI/PSS candidate02 imports u_bridge and u_gpio; bound SPI remains native. Native public results match across all four audited edit states.
implementationNotes.overallQualification: Current fixed-root sibling closure binary passes16 unrestricted projects x4 public diagnostic/hover states:11whole/5partial, SoC161/OpenOFDM41 imports, zero capacity skips.1040CTest and24614assertions/92scope cases pass;3471/3focused assertions cover same-root sibling/dependency closure, outside mutable provider and macro boundaries, Native semantic/CheckUnused parity, error/repair. Unsafe same-file native remainders, current-model namespace import refusal details, finite-contract proof reconciliation, complete frozen-code queries, rebuiltASan, formal latency/RSS and release remain incomplete.
implementationNotes.aggregateProvenance: One direct value-binding rule is shared by runtime expression and constant initializer audits. Fields are type metadata; casts and selects derive ownership from operands. Local unpacked structs/arrays and shared package variables reuse; outside-base accesses reject. Module selectors now include instantiated descendants; compact owners admit only exact roots verified against the selected native graph.
implementationNotes.runtimeBinderFamilies: NonConstantFunction and SimpleSystemTask opt in through final fixed-signature input binders plus final non-constant evaluation; methods, outputs/lvalue signatures and with-state excluded. Result type certified separately. Runtime random/file state never cached. Native constant errors and outside/nested argument rejection covered.
implementationNotes.declarationSubsets: Cross-unit closed declaration graph excludes unavailable/ambiguous/source-library/opaque dependencies, propagates rejection through parents and indivisible physical roots, and retains independent descendants. OpenOFDM now prepares 12 declarations and imports 41 subtrees after structural/error/repair edits; original 14 errors remain 14/14/15/14 including intentional consumer error.
implementationNotes.semanticErrorPeeling: A composed provider error with a known physical root excludes that root, shared-file declarations and dependent parents; rebuild a fresh semantic owner until valid or empty. Each retry removes a root. Multiple errors in one root do not discard independent declarations. Errors without safe root attribution use Native. Four fixture combinations cover mixed/nonmixed files and independent/single units, with native timeunit precision/redeclaration errors and mutable consumer error/repair; 312 assertions pass.
implementationNotes.refusalReporting: Compiler/body cache first-cause refusal reports remain bounded and charged. Declaration preparation now has its own structured route/exclusion report; these stages are distinct. Requested/prepared/retained/current-import counts remain separate. Complete same-fixed-file best-effort subset review remains pending.
implementationNotes.importedInstantiationMetadata: Imported fixed definitions preserve Native parser global-instantiation occurrences scoped to that declaration. This includes inactive generate branches for Native top / unused-definition discovery, without copying unrelated provider metadata. Discovery skips inactive generate scopes; full and compact owners, active and dormant branches, Native semantic/usage/flow parity pass 160 assertions. Real SoC remaining warning and package-usage differences persist.
implementationNotes.nativeProfileFidelity: Hierarchy write/call origins are captured per body; only current visited bodies schedule Native deferred canonical invalidation. Retained root/descendant frames are mapped without mutating owners; raw occurrence dedup permits previously skipped descendant diagnostics on revisits. Constants preserve Native usage direction. Class diagnostics replay at existing sorted specialization visits, and certified CU-class scopes use current-consumer reference profiles rather than whole-owner old caller uses. Generic compact/full-owner, indexed/unindexed, active/dormant, different-width and outside-read/remove/read controls pass.
implementationNotes.patternLoopMetadata: Local PatternVar symbols admitted through ordinary value-type / usage rules. VariablePattern audits bound variable ownership, StructurePattern / TaggedPattern audit omitted field aggregate/type metadata, for loops audit declared variables, foreach statements/constraints audit hidden dimension variables, and IteratorSymbol audits retained arrayType. Pattern-loop fixture was red6 before implementation and passes92 assertions after it in4 compact/full x pattern/no-pattern combinations, including multidimensional/skipped foreach, unused for declaration, variable/constant/wildcard struct patterns, semantic/unused diagnostics and3 edit states. This does not qualify every pattern/constraint context or remove existing type/class admission limits.
implementationNotes.finiteKindBoundary: Explicit knownBodyReuseKind switches enumerate111 noninvalid kinds across7 non-symbol AST families. Every overload defaults false, with compile-time unknown-value assertions; symbol kinds retain their separate explicit switch/default refusal. This is an inventory gate only, not a claim all listed kinds are supported or fully qualified. Existing type/context/ownership and hidden-metadata checks remain decisive. Inventory regeneration cross-checks actual switch membership against pinned enums and retains review/evidence notes.
implementationNotes.foldedAssertionBounds: Five inline assertion negative families exposed30 unsafe publication/import assertions before the fix: delay scalar, delay range, unbounded upper range, repetition scalar and repetition range referencing a mutable package. Original bound expressions are now recorded through the existing body elaboration-control mechanism before folding. Both range endpoints and unbounded cases are covered. Local and fixed-package positives retain reuse. Expanded fixture varies mutable DELAY independently of body W across four states and passes1308 assertions in compact/full owners and remains green in the final kind-gate full-suite/16-project cohort.
implementationNotes.typeOperatorSources: A native-valid assignment pattern type(mutable_keys::key):value lost the original type source after resolution to builtin int/longint. Changing only the mutable package variable type reproduced2 stale initializer values plus10 unsafe publication/import assertions in compact/full owners. Type::fromSyntax now records original type-operator operands as type-only controls. Structured assignment type/field setters certify hidden identities through shared aggregate/type rules. Controls and queued types/prototypes are closed together; copied vector entries remain valid across lazy binding, and repeated expressions are deduplicated separately by value/type-only mode. Type-only fixed-provider dependencies do not demand runtime usage completeness. Targeted positives include local/fixed type queries, imported fixed type alias, explicit member setters, mutable type changes/repair, Native semantic/unused diagnostics and evaluated initializer parity.417 focused assertions and full1037CTest/23098scope assertions pass, along with all16 unrestricted real-project audits.
implementationNotes.declarationPreparationReporting: Scope status now separates immutable library-owned preparation reports from body certification. Chosen routes retain per-declaration first-cause counts; tentative closed/subset attempts are tracked separately and never become false exclusions if a later prefix route retains those declarations. Reports copy only bounded values:32 categories,8 total declaration samples,8 route attempts,160-byte UTF-8-boundary strings; complete excluded counts include uncategorized totals. Retained report storage is charged in published provider semantic bytes and separately observable. Generic syntax/semantic-root rejection, unavailable/dependency propagation, shared physical roots, fallback, bounds and manual repair/rebuild are tested. Rebuild refreshes reports without mutating old snapshots and preserves unsaved consumers.2273 assertions across4 focused cases pass; all16 unrestricted project audits verify preparation/body coverage arithmetic, bounds, one used route and Native public parity. Remaining fixed-file subset generalization and final support proof reconciliation are separate gates.
implementationNotes.fixedRootSiblingClosure: RTL subset preparation first fixes the physical roots of eligible requested graph nodes, then includes module/interface/program sibling declarations touching those roots. Their dependencies must close inside this preexisting root set; extra macro origins and outside module providers reject with explicit categories. Ambiguous sibling declarations are rejected before provider binding. No mutable provider is pulled in. Harmless two-hop sibling chains now preserve larger safe subtree imports rather than reducing to leaves. Positive/negative unit contexts, provider availability, syntax/semantic errors, current external edits and Native semantic/CheckUnused parity pass3471 focused assertions across3 cases. Mutable macro-source changes demonstrate current values and strict namespace fallback: tokens remain equal while leading directive trivia differs. This existing guard was retained, with an explicit witness test. Same-file unsafe native remainders and current-model namespace refusal details remain pending; see native-remainder-review.json.
implementationNotes.compilationUnitProviders: Native declaration-origin mapping retains CU imports, closed classes/typedefs/hoisted enum exports and simple file-scope functions/tasks in original order. Same-unit and physical-root proofs fail closed; extern/forward/mixed providers remain native. Module type-name edges defer to actual elaborated-frame certification, including inactive alternatives, without admitting names used in other eager contexts.
implementationNotes.fixedSourceAnalysisValidation: Construction and cached validation use the same certified provider source tree and buffer. Provider namespace / edited-overlay validation remains active. Six failing repeated-identity assertions reproduced native-vs-projected tree mismatch; after repair 109 scope cases/32679 assertions pass. Native remainders continue using native owner resolution.
implementationNotes.weakNamespaceProof: Full namespace equality proof is memoized only for the same provider object and ordered immutable configured-tree identities. All keys are weak; expired/replaced trees or rebuilt library force proof recomputation. Both positive and negative results are cached. Each query still checks fixed editor overlays. Native duplicate declaration/error/repair controls and existing lifetime/source retirement tests pass.
